data.name: Primal
data.detailed_description:
About the Game:

This is a vast open-world survival game, You will be a primitive man surviving on a wild continent teeming with giant beasts. Gather resources, develop civilization, build homes, craft weapons, fight dinosaurs, defeat them, tame them, and ultimately rule this mysterious world.

Game Features:

  • Rich natural ecology, with a variety of dinosaurs of different shapes and colors.

  • Hunting, taming, and feeding dinosaurs, and riding them.

  • A highly customizable building system, allowing you to construct various buildings.

  • Rich crafting system, allowing you to craft a variety of weapons and tools.

  • A vast world to freely explore, with a realistic dynamic weather system and day/night cycle.

  • Supports single-player and multiplayer modes.

  • Supports free switching between first-person and third-person perspectives.
